title: Classified Navy diver unit experimenting with liquid breathing

tellings.quote: There is a There is a a a special unit, I'm not going to say exactly where, of Navy divers that have experimented with that technology.

plain: A former top Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet says there is a special unit of Navy divers that has experimented with liquid breathing, where a diver breathes a fluid instead of air. He tells Michels this as someone who knows about it directly, but he will not say where the unit is based. If true, it would mean the Navy is quietly testing technology that lets people go deeper under the sea.
